name: Wooden Jewellery Box
description: A beautifully handcrafted wooden jewellery box made by skilled local artisans using quality wood. It features an elegant traditional design with detailed carvings and a smooth finish. The box provides convenient storage for rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets and other accessories. Its attractive appearance makes it a perfect decorative item for dressing tables and a thoughtful gift for birthdays, weddings and special occasions. Each piece reflects the creativity and craftsmanship of local artisans.

name: Handmade pot
description: Full handmade craft by local partitions using natural clay it features a traditional design in elegant finish. Perfect for home decoration, living rooms and gifting. Each piece is handmade with care and supports local craftsmanship.
